data.gender_notes: Nuwwara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nuwwar', which means 'moonlight'. In Islamic tradition, Nuwwara symbolizes guidance, protection, and tranquility, as the moon lights the way during the darkest nights. The name is associated with the blessings of the Almighty Allah. The name Nuwwara carries the meaning “Light of the moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuwwara usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
